import pandas as pd

# Paths to source CSV files
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_98/test_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_98/test_1.csv"

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column
df_source0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df_source1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# df_source0 schema: ['right_index', '0']
# df_source1 schema: ['0']

# Join df_source0 and df_source1 on df_source0.right_index == df_source1.index
# This is an inner join to match the 500 rows in df_source1 (target row count)
df_joined = pd.merge(
    df_source0,
    df_source1,
    left_on='right_index',
    right_index=True,
    how='inner',
    suffixes=('_x', '_y')
)

# Select only the columns required by the target schema: ['0_x', '0_y']
df_target = df_joined[['0_x', '0_y']].copy()

# Ensure columns are float type as per target schema
df_target['0_x'] = df_target['0_x'].astype(float)
df_target['0_y'] = df_target['0_y'].astype(float)

# Write the transformed data to the target CSV file without the index
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_98/target_multisource.csv"
df_target.to_csv(target_path, index=False)
